description:
MILTON KEYNES' BEST APARTMENT? WE THINK SO...

Commanding one of the finest positions within this prestigious canal-side development, this exceptional three-bedroom penthouse apartment offers luxurious contemporary living, breath-taking panoramic views and an outstanding wrap-around roof terrace that truly sets it apart.

Beautifully designed throughout, the apartment offers generous, light-filled accommodation centred around an impressive open-plan living, dining and kitchen area. Floor-to-ceiling glazing maximises the stunning outlook while flooding the space with natural light, creating the perfect environment for both everyday living and entertaining. The contemporary kitchen is finished to a high specification with quality integrated appliances, sleek cabinetry and ample workspace, seamlessly flowing into the spacious living and dining areas.

The property features three excellent double bedrooms, including a superb principal suite complete with fitted wardrobes and a stylish en-suite shower room. The remaining bedrooms are equally well-proportioned and are served by a beautifully appointed family bathroom. High-quality finishes, generous storage and meticulous attention to detail are evident throughout.

Without doubt, the standout feature is the spectacular wrap-around roof terrace which enjoys uninterrupted panoramic views across the Grand Union Canal, the vibrant Campbell Wharf Marina and the surrounding countryside beyond. From sunrise to sunset, the ever-changing waterside scenery creates a stunning backdrop, with colourful narrowboats gliding through the marina, mature trees lining the canal and the landmark footbridge leading to the popular canal-side pub, café and restaurant. Looking beyond, the elevated position provides far-reaching views across Milton Keynes' green landscape, offering a rare combination of waterside tranquillity and open countryside. Whether entertaining friends, enjoying morning coffee or relaxing with a glass of wine as the sun sets over the marina, this exceptional outlook provides a lifestyle that is simply unrivalled.

Further benefits include two allocated parking spaces conveniently positioned immediately outside the apartment entrance, secure entry to the building and a lease with approximately 242 years remaining, providing excellent long-term security.

Combining outstanding design, generous accommodation and arguably one of the finest roof terraces in Milton Keynes, this truly is a rare opportunity to acquire one of the area's most impressive penthouse apartments.
keyFeatures: Superb Views Over Grand Union Canal, Marina and Beyond.
